title: Matillion Job and Component Failures
dataSources: Matillion task API (`matillion:task`), component logs, and Informatica/Talend session logs (`informatica:session`).
app: Matillion API (`/rest/v1/group/.../task`) and Matillion task logs via HEC scripted inputs; Informatica/Talend session logs where present.
spl:
index=bi sourcetype=matillion:task state="FAILED" OR success="false"
| stats count as failures, values(message) as messages by job_name, component_name
| where failures>0
| sort - failures
description: Counts failed Matillion orchestration/transformation tasks down to the failing component so engineers land directly on the broken step.
value: Component-level failure detail cuts triage time on Matillion ELT jobs that feed cloud warehouses.
implementation: Poll the Matillion task API into HEC; schedule every 15 minutes and alert on failures for production jobs.
visualization: Table of job/component by failures with messages.
grandmaExplanation: We watch the cloud data-loading jobs and point you at the exact broken step so it is fixed quickly.
